items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Thought I heard Buddy Boehme say.

ctx.x: Before you were telling me. Well you see, I used to, but I was playing, I used to go back there, I remember, I remember once, they was playing at Johnson Park. I was Johnson Park. Oh. Right, see, Johnson Park was like, here, Lincoln Park was here. See? And, and Bab Frank Piller's band, Yeah. Bab Frank had a brass band, and had his orchestra too. Yeah. So they had this brass band playing, over at Lincoln Park, and Buddy Boehme, cut that, see, because, I'd slip in there, and short pants, and hide from the cops,…
Remember the balloon ascensions, when they grew up, and Buddy Boehme and the balloon ascensions? Buddy Boehme on Sunday evening,
